fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Skills / spells (583 x 1140). Descriptions (148 B x5) at +0x0C, names (48 B x5) at +0x2F0; numeric block at +0x3E0: 6 effect slots (type u8 + value i16), type/weapon/element/formula bytes, skill-EXP and per-level power tables, range, AttackMap shape, height limits, combo partners, owner char ids (user1..4), animation id, base/dual links. Learnsets are in char.dat (+0x14: 16 x u32 magic ids, +0x54: 16 x u16 learn levels); weapon skills are learned by weapon mastery (learn_level); generic spells/evilities are also sold via ItemGetSkillDataBase.dat.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: skill id (key). Ranges: 1-22 system/Base-Panel commands, 101-607 weapon skills (hundreds digit = weapon: 1 fist 2 sword 3 spear 4 bow 5 gun 6 axe), 911-984 system/tower/throw-item skills, 1001-1906 generic spells (10xx fire 11xx wind 12xx ice 13xx star 14xx heal 15xx buff 16xx debuff 17xx ailment 19xx geo), 3000-3047 Overload skills (see OverlordSkill.dat), 9001-9005 Dummy spell templates, 10011-10811 character unique skills, 11011-11262 generic-class skills, 12011-12613 monster-class skills, 2xxxx Magichange skills, 3xxxx combo (team-up) skills. Referenced by char.dat learnsets (+0x14), ItemGetSkillDataBase.dat.

fields.name: sub_type
fields.desc: 0 for most skills. Throw-item skills 960-984: 1 physical objects (spear, axe, ball), 3 elemental/holy items (scrolls, gems), 4 healing items, 5 small objects (knife, darts, medal, rose), 7 ninja star, 8 bomb. Magichange skills use 1,3,6,7,8 (probably Magichange weapon/visual class). Not verified in game.

fields.name: sp_cost
fields.desc: base SP cost (Fire 4, Mega 16, Giga 49, Omega 96, Tera 128; weapon skills 4/12/24/48/96/160/255; Braveheart 8; unique skills 10/30/72/160; Overload 1)

fields.name: learn_level
fields.desc: weapon skills: Weapon Mastery level needed (1,3,7,15,25,50; 999 for the ultimate 7th skill); tower skills 5..30; 0 for skills learned through char.dat learnsets or shops

fields.name: rank
fields.desc: tier inside the skill family: weapon skills 0..6, spells 0/2/4/6/8 (Fire..Tera), buffs 1, unique 0..3, Magichange 0/1 and 4 for the Dual Magichange version
